Prologue · Le Locle序章 · 雷克尔

Transfer a 1st Chapter clear save before starting if available. Explore Rolent's field items, then complete the Le Locle training route through Balstar Channel, Saint-Croix Forest and Grimsel Fortress.如有存档，开始前先继承 1st Chapter 通关数据。收集洛连特地图道具，然后完成巴尔斯塔尔水道、圣科洛瓦森林和古林塞尔要塞的训练路线。
